name: OniLink Bedrock Edge System
author: TheNINJALLO@users.noreply.github.com
description: OniLink is a standalone Java 21 Bedrock edge system with fail-closed OniForward identity forwarding, tenant-aware operations modules, an installable dashboard PWA, and native OniBridge control. This 0.3 beta egg verifies its bootstrap release and atomically follows the selected stable, beta, or pinned channel.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

install_root=/mnt/server
mkdir -p "${install_root}"
cd "${install_root}"

case "${ONILINK_VERSION}" in
    *[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*|'')
        echo "Invalid ONILINK_VERSION: ${ONILINK_VERSION}" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac

base_url="https://github.com/TheNINJALLO/OniLink/releases/download/${ONILINK_VERSION}"

download() {
    asset=$1
    destination=$2
    echo "Downloading ${asset} from ${ONILINK_VERSION}..."
    curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 15 \
        "${base_url}/${asset}" -o "${destination}"
}

rm -f OniLink.jar.download onilink.properties.example.download start-onilink.sh.download SHA256SUMS.download
download OniLink.jar OniLink.jar.download
download onilink.properties.example onilink.properties.example.download
download start-onilink.sh start-onilink.sh.download
download SHA256SUMS SHA256SUMS.download

jar_sha=$(awk '$2 == "OniLink.jar" { print $1 }' SHA256SUMS.download)
config_sha=$(awk '$2 == "onilink.properties.example" { print $1 }' SHA256SUMS.download)
startup_sha=$(awk '$2 == "start-onilink.sh" { print $1 }' SHA256SUMS.download)
if [[ ! "${jar_sha}" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$ ]] || [[ ! "${config_sha}" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$ ]] || [[ ! "${startup_sha}" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$ ]]; then
    echo "Release checksum entries are missing or malformed." >&2
    exit 3
fi
printf '%s  %s\n' "${jar_sha}" OniLink.jar.download | sha256sum -c -
printf '%s  %s\n' "${config_sha}" onilink.properties.example.download | sha256sum -c -
printf '%s  %s\n' "${startup_sha}" start-onilink.sh.download | sha256sum -c -

mv OniLink.jar.download "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
mv onilink.properties.example.download onilink.properties.example
mv start-onilink.sh.download start-onilink.sh
mv SHA256SUMS.download SHA256SUMS
chmod 0755 start-onilink.sh

if [[ ! -f "${CONFIG_FILE}" ]]; then
    cp onilink.properties.example "${CONFIG_FILE}"
    echo "Created ${CONFIG_FILE} from the release template."
else
    echo "Preserved existing ${CONFIG_FILE}. Compare it with onilink.properties.example after upgrades."
fi

mkdir -p cache dashboard logs plugins resource-packs
echo "OniLink bootstrap ${ONILINK_VERSION} installed and verified."
echo "Each container start now checks the ${ONILINK_UPDATE_CHANNEL:-stable} update channel."
echo "Set the admin-only ONIBRIDGE_FORWARDING_SECRET before starting the proxy."

variables.name: OniLink bootstrap release tag
variables.description: Exact public GitHub release used during create/reinstall and when the update channel is pinned.

variables.name: Automatic update channel
variables.description: beta installs the newest published release including prereleases; stable ignores prereleases; pinned stays on the exact OniLink bootstrap release tag.

variables.name: Server jar file
variables.description: Fixed runtime JAR name used by the verified installer and automatic startup updater.

variables.name: Configuration file
variables.description: Fixed OniLink configuration path. Existing configuration is preserved on reinstall.

variables.name: Enable operations dashboard
variables.description: Serves the authenticated dashboard over TCP on the same numeric primary allocation used by Bedrock UDP. Disable it if dashboard access is provided another way.

variables.name: Dashboard owner setup code
variables.description: ADMIN ONLY. Optional one-time setup code for automated tenant provisioning. Leave blank for a randomly generated code in dashboard/FIRST_RUN_SETUP.txt.

variables.name: Enable authenticated XUID allowlist
variables.description: Rejects Xbox-authenticated players whose XUID is not in allowlist.properties. Add your own XUID from the dashboard or console before enabling this setting.

variables.name: Default backend host
variables.description: Private hostname or IP reachable from the OniLink container. Do not use a public player address.

variables.name: Default backend UDP port
variables.description: Private Bedrock UDP allocation of the default BDS backend.

variables.name: Server list MOTD
variables.description: First line shown in the Bedrock server list.

variables.name: Advertised player limit
variables.description: Player count advertised by OniLink. This is presentation, not an enforcement limit.

variables.name: Enable OniControl
variables.description: Enables the optional typed backend-control channel for the default backend. Keep disabled until the matching OniBridge control block and a dedicated TCP allocation/private route are configured.

variables.name: OniControl safety mode
variables.description: advisor requires dashboard preview and confirmation; enforce permits already-authorized typed actions. Start with advisor.

variables.name: OniBridge private control IP
variables.description: Private numeric IP used only for OniControl TCP. It is not the player-facing UDP address. Public cleartext addresses are rejected.

variables.name: OniBridge control TCP port
variables.description: Dedicated TCP allocation listened to by OniBridge and reached by OniLink. This is separate from both Bedrock UDP ports and the dashboard port.

variables.name: OniControl bridge ID
variables.description: Must exactly match control.bridge_id in the OniBridge TOML for the default backend.

variables.name: OniControl backend name
variables.description: Exact configured backend route name carried in signed control envelopes.

variables.name: OniControl key ID
variables.description: Non-secret rotation label that must match OniBridge control.key_id.

variables.name: Allow private cleartext control route
variables.description: Set true only when CONTROL_HOST is a trusted private IP or loopback tunnel. HMAC authentication remains mandatory, but transport contents are not encrypted.

variables.name: Enable OniControl TLS client
variables.description: Requires a TLS-enabled control endpoint, validated server name, and CA/pin. The bundled native bridge currently rejects TLS until its reviewed TLS transport is available.

variables.name: OniControl TLS server name
variables.description: Certificate hostname used by the Java TLS client; required only when TLS is enabled.

variables.name: OniControl certificate SHA-256 pin
variables.description: ADMIN ONLY. Optional 64-character lowercase/uppercase certificate fingerprint without colons.

variables.name: Enable OniPacket rules
variables.description: Enables persisted typed packet rules in both relay directions. Rules still start empty and are managed from the OniControl dashboard.

variables.name: Enable per-player virtualization
variables.description: Enables safety-bounded virtual inventory sessions. Unsupported virtual actions remain rejected explicitly.

variables.name: Enable Protocol Lab
variables.description: OWNER-ONLY EXPERIMENTAL GATE. Keep disabled in production. Enabling also requires explicit test XUID and backend allowlists.

variables.name: Protocol Lab test XUIDs
variables.description: ADMIN ONLY. Comma-separated Xbox XUID allowlist used only by the disabled-by-default Protocol Lab gate.

variables.name: Protocol Lab test backends
variables.description: ADMIN ONLY. Comma-separated backend route allowlist for Protocol Lab.

variables.name: Default OniControl secret
variables.description: ADMIN ONLY. Standard Base64 for at least 32 random bytes. Must match OniBridge control.secret_environment and must never equal the OniForward secret.

variables.name: Default OniForward secret
variables.description: ADMIN ONLY. Standard Base64 for at least 32 random bytes. Must equal the default backend validator secret. Never include this value in an exported egg.

variables.name: Survival backend OniForward secret
variables.description: ADMIN ONLY. Optional secret for configurations using ONIBRIDGE_SURVIVAL_SECRET. It must differ from every other backend secret.
